answer: Mechanism: Voyage-Sparrow Curve. Each new agent must complete a verifiable-delay-function “voyage”; its iteration count is base × (1 + d)^1.5, where d is the density of agents sharing a hardware/network fingerprint in that epoch’s garden. No admission cap—anyone can pay. A sparrow-scale operator adding one agent pays near base; a sybil farm sharing hosts sees marginal compute/energy cost grow superlinearly, so N identities cost O(N^2.5).
